correctness.rationale: The all-parameter argument normalizes every shortest admissible reset word, reduces to two weighted transformations on n-1 states, proves closure of inverse cyclic intervals and exact inverse cases, verifies a parity-sensitive Bellman potential for all allowed transitions, constructs a path attaining the potential, and algebraically simplifies its cost. The included original-power-automaton BFS, reverse-interval Dijkstra, all-edge potential tests and concrete witnesses were actually run; finite checks support rather than replace the proof.

originality.rationale: The exact shortest no-aaa reset length for every n>=3 is not entailed by either regular-constraint existence/complexity results or known unrestricted reset bounds. The closest indexed exact Černý results optimize unrestricted costs, extension of a single inverse set, early rank deficiency, or one-symbol excess; their claims and underlying assumptions do not give the new forbidden-factor length. A separate earlier exact rotation-run feasibility threshold lacks a sharp length. Repeated indexed searches and inspections of primary full text yielded no covering equivalence, with residual unindexed-history risk acknowledged.
residual_risks: Search indexes and accessible records are not an exhaustive historical priority proof; unindexed notes or another equivalent optimization theorem might exist.
The published record is evidence of reported results, not an independent validation of the present proof.
